title: Custom-chat-mod
description: Customizable centered chat with player heads, custom nicknames and colored names
body:
# Custom Chat Mod

A clean and customizable chat mod that displays messages in the center of your screen with player heads and colored nicknames.

---

## ✨ Features

### 💬 Centered Chat
Messages appear in the center of your screen instead of the bottom-left corner. Clean, modern and easy to read!

### 🖼️ Player Heads
Shows player heads next to each message for better visibility and a nicer look.

### ✏️ Custom Nicknames
Change your display name in chat without changing your actual username.

### 🎨 Colored Names
Customize your nickname color with 14 available colors to stand out in chat.

### 📐 Dynamic Width
Chat box automatically adjusts its width based on message length.

---

## 🎮 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/chatname <name>` | Set your custom nickname |
| `/chatname reset` | Reset to default nickname |
| `/chatcolor <color>` | Change your name color |
| `/clearchat` | Clear chat history |

---

## 🎨 Available Colors

- **Red:** `red`, `dark_red`
- **Blue:** `blue`, `aqua`
- **Green:** `green`, `dark_green`
- **Yellow:** `yellow`, `gold`
- **Purple:** `purple`, `light_purple`
- **Gray:** `gray`, `dark_gray`
- **Other:** `white`, `black`

---

## 💡 Perfect For

- **Roleplay servers** - Custom NPC names and colors
- **Story maps** - Clean centered dialogue
- **Streamers** - Better chat visibility for viewers
- **Everyone** - Cleaner chat experience

---

## 📦 Installation

1. Install Forge 1.19.2
2. Download the mod
3. Place the `.jar` file in your `.minecraft/mods/` folder
4. Launch the game and enjoy!
